title: 第九章  月,少年心事
content_zh:
妖兽之林,一轮残月。

    江尘面无表情的坐在地上,手里拿着一根串着妖兽肉的树枝,正平静的烤着肉。一旁的虎芸也是阴沉着脸,有些无聊似的,不停地拨弄着火堆里面的柴火。

    终于,虎芸有些忍不住了,轻声问道:“江尘哥哥,你究竟怎么了?从我们离开那处寒潭算起,你已经好几个时辰没有说话了。难道是你刺穿了商战的手臂,你担心他的家人会向你下手吗?”

    江尘本在沉思中,听到虎芸的话,这才回过神来,勉强挤出一个微笑,说道:“我并非惧怕商战或者说他的家人会向我下手,而是发现了一件事,正在犹豫要不要告诉落神宗而已。”

    “哦?不知道江尘哥哥你发现了什么事,能告诉芸儿吗?”虎芸眨着小眼睛,很是好奇的问道。

    江尘整理了一下思绪这才说道:“其实这件事情,或许你也看见了。白天我一枪刺穿了商战的手臂,让他疼得在地上来回打滚。不过,当时你的距离尚远,究竟是怎么一回事你却根本不知道。”

    虎芸点点头,事实上她的确只看到江尘一枪刺穿商战的手臂。至于为什么江尘在商战已经败了的情况下会突然下手,她却不知道,也一直没好意思问。

    “其实,我的那招龙神降世,已经将商战的流星剑完全破解了。不过,我却看到瘫坐在地上的商战全身颤抖,他的眼睛居然在渐渐由黑变红,而他的手上居然出现了一个黑色的印记。”江尘继续说道。

    “黑色印记?可据我所知,商战的家族可是当今神皇陛下的宠妃,商妃商诗嫣所在的家族。他的家族很早便跟随着神皇陛下征战,或许那道黑色印记只不过是一个普通的印记,没有什么特殊含义。又或许那是某个秘密组织的印记也说不定,我不明白江尘哥哥你怎么那么紧张那个印记。”虎芸说道。

    江尘却是摇摇头,说道:“芸儿,如果我没猜错的话,你所在的家族定然也不比商战差。难道你的父亲、母亲都没有给你讲过关于那道黑色印记的事情?”

    虎芸仔细想了想,隐约间好像记得她的父亲,曾经似乎说过关于一个黑色印记的事情,还曾经叮嘱她要是遇到有黑色印记的人,尽量远离其人。最好是向帝国报告,帝国会派人处理的。

    不过虎芸却不敢相信,如果江尘所说的那个黑色印记果真与自己父亲所说的同一种印记的话,这件事便不是简单的事情了。

    “江尘哥哥,你能将那个印记的样子,画在地上吗?”虎芸努力克制着自己有些慌乱的心,说道。

    江尘点点头,随手拿起一根树枝,很是认真的在地上画了出来。当虎芸看到江尘所画的图案时,整个人都被深深的震惊了。
content_en:
In the forest of monsters, there is a waning moon.

    Jiang Chen sat on the ground with an expressionless expression, holding a branch with monster meat on it in his hand and roasting the meat calmly. Hu Yun on the side also had a gloomy face, as if a little bored, and kept fiddling with the firewood in the fire.

    Finally, Hu Yun couldn't bear it any longer and asked softly: "Brother Jiang Chen, what happened to you? You haven't spoken for several hours since we left the cold pool. Could it be that you pierced Shang Zhan's arm and are you worried that his family will attack you?"

    Jiang Chen was deep in thought, and when he heard Hu Yun's words, he came back to his senses, forced out a smile, and said, "I'm not afraid of the business war or that his family will attack me, but I discovered something and am hesitating whether to tell the Luo Shen Sect."

    "Oh? I don't know what brother Jiang Chen has discovered. Can you tell Yun'er?" Hu Yun blinked her little eyes and asked curiously.

    Jiang Chen collected his thoughts and then said: "Actually, maybe you have also seen this matter. During the day, I pierced Shang Zhan's arm with a gun, causing him to roll back and forth on the ground in pain. However, you were still far away at that time, so you had no idea what was going on."

    Hu Yun nodded. In fact, she only saw Jiang Chen stabbing Shang Zhan's arm with a spear. As for why Jiang Chen suddenly took action when the business war was already lost, she didn't know, and she never had the nerve to ask.

    "Actually, my move Dragon God Comes to the World has completely cracked Shang Zhan's Meteor Sword. However, I saw Shang Zhan slumped on the ground shaking all over. His eyes were gradually turning from black to red, and a black mark actually appeared on his hand." Jiang Chen continued.

    "Black mark? But as far as I know, Shang Zhan's family is the family of His Majesty the God Emperor's favorite concubine, Shang Shiyan. His family has followed His Majesty the God Emperor to fight for a long time. Maybe that black mark is just an ordinary mark with no special meaning. Or maybe it is the mark of a secret organization. I don't understand why Brother Jiang Chen is so nervous about that mark," Hu Yun said.

    Jiang Chen shook his head and said, "Yun'er, if I'm not wrong, your family must be no worse than Shang Zhan. Didn't your father and mother tell you about that black mark?"

    Huyun thought about it carefully and vaguely seemed to remember that her father once seemed to have said something about a black mark. He also told her that if she met someone with a black mark, she should try to stay away from them. It's best to report it to the empire, and the empire will send someone to deal with it.

    However, Hu Yun couldn't believe it. If the black mark Jiang Chen mentioned was really the same mark as her father said, this matter would not be a simple matter.

    "Brother Jiang Chen, can you draw the appearance of that mark on the ground?" Hu Yun said while trying to restrain her panic.

    Jiang Chen nodded, picked up a branch, and drew it on the ground very seriously. When Hu Yun saw the pattern drawn by Jiang Chen, she was deeply shocked.
